sources.title: 秋月 Acer Shirasawanum 'Autumn Moon'
sources.description: 非常著名的羽团扇品种，十九世纪 70 年代由 J.D.Vertrees 选育，和金隐Aureum为同代品种，秋月以叶色多变著称， 春叶为橙黄色和黄色，五月开始新抽稍为黄橙红色，与 绿色的老叶形成鲜明的对比，秋叶色彩丰富，有时候红 色，橙色，黄色会出现在同一张叶子上。长势偏慢，夏 季怕热，需要午后遮阴，直立生长，成年树可达 2 米， 在美国 Oregon 有树体达 4 米的秋月。

sources.name: Aureum Autumn Moon
sources.description: The Autumn Moon Japanese Maple is a stunning tree that offers year-round beauty with its unique foliage and striking form. This variety features large, rounded leaves with a beautiful blend of pale yellow and green tones in spring, which gradually change to vibrant shades of orange, gold, and red in the autumn, creating a fiery display of colour. The delicate, broad leaves and graceful branching make it a standout choice for adding texture and elegance to any landscape. Reaching a height of 3 to 4 meters, the Autumn Moon is an ideal choice for medium-sized gardens or as a specimen tree. Its vibrant autumn colour and attractive form make it a perfect focal point in your garden. Additionally, it is well-suited for container planting, making it a great choice for patios or smaller spaces. The Japanese Maple thrives in well-drained, slightly acidic soil and enjoys partial shade, making it relatively easy to care for. Once established, it is a low-maintenance tree that provides stunning seasonal changes and a unique look in your garden. At Herter Nursery, we carefully cultivate Autumn Moon Japanese Maples for sale to ensure strong, healthy growth. Shop today to bring the beauty and elegance of this exceptional tree into your landscape.

rhs.description: A bushy tree or large shrub, up to about 6m high, with grey-brown bark, and rounded eleven-lobed leaves about 6cm across. Leaves are clear yellow or yellowish-green, but in full sun are green with yellowish veins; in both situations they are tinged burnt-orange and turn orange-red in autumn. Cream and pink flowers, in spring, are held in upright spreading clusters, and are followed by winged near-horizontal greenish-brown fruits about 2cm across

attributes.suggested_uses: Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden

care.cultivation: Grow in moist but well-drained acidic or neutral soil in partial shade or full sun; for more advice, see Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 (little or no pruning of trees and shrubs)

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种小型乔木，叶色颇具观赏性，呈少见的焦橙色，底色带有绿色基调。在全日照条件下，这些色彩表现最为强烈。叶片也带有淡黄绿色调。秋季时，叶片转为浓艳的橙色和红色。叶形属于该类日本枫的典型类型。显著的中脉在部分叶片上呈锈色。该品种似乎较耐热，宜栽植于阳光充足之处，以充分展现叶色。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 一种丛生小乔木或大型灌木，高可达约 6 米；树皮灰褐色。叶片近圆形，11 裂，宽约 6 厘米。叶色为明黄或黄绿色；在全日照下则呈绿色，叶脉带黄；两种环境下叶片均略带焦橙色，秋季转为橙红色。春季开奶油色至粉色花，直立开展成簇；随后结近水平展开的翅果，果色绿褐，宽约 2 厘米。

attributes.suggested_uses: 低养护、庭院/容器植物、城市/庭院花园、乡村风/自然式花园

care.cultivation: 宜栽植于湿润但排水良好的酸性或中性土壤中，可置于半阴或全日照环境；更多信息参见 Japanese maple cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组（树木和灌木通常无需修剪或仅需极少修剪）。
